headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a thrilling 4-6 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, outscoring them 6-4. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians.

Several key players have been affected by injuries, impacting their team's availability. The Los Angeles Dodgers transferred right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Boston Red Sox transferred 2B Isiah Kiner-Falefa to the 60-day injured list. The New York Yankees placed RHP Kervin Castro on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to right elbow neuritis. Other teams have also made injury-related moves, including the Cincinnati Reds, Toronto Blue Jays, Miami Marlins, San Francisco Giants, and Colorado Rockies.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Kansas City Royals acquired 1B Jacob Berry in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling 4-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a hard-fought win against the Cleveland Guardians, outscoring them 6-4. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Pirates in 2-0 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 2-0. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run, driving in one run in two at-bats.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 win over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save, pitching 1.1 innings with 2 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Mariners 4-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Randy Arozarena leading the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 5 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Treinen Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The move comes after he was initially placed on the 15-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have acquired 1B Jacob Berry in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster after being dealt to the team.
